description: Make coupled MTP drafts the default (runtime.mtp_coupled_drafts on unless a record turns it off). Every drafting fixture that did not set the option now couples: each rank loads the unchanged locked draft noise module, resolves its one entry and allocates its noise records; the drafter graphs each capture one more node, the draft noise launch, so their creators are declared removed and added. Exact operation edits add each drafter run's record uploads and the draft noise launch before each argmax partial; every retained operation is compared under the ordered handle map.
